name: City Building and Cultural Vitality
description: Identifying opportunities to address program needs while creating a range of city-building benefits designed to improve the quality of life for Torontonians is one of our priorities as an agency.

name: Economic Development
description: Using the City’s real estate to create opportunities for job creation is one of the ways CreateTO is working to ensure Toronto is a place where businesses and residents can thrive.

name: Environmental Sustainability
description: As the City’s strategic real estate arm, climate action is at the forefront of CreateTO’s thinking in order to advance the City’s objectives to reduce community-wide greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in Toronto to net-zero by 2040.
